ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the lobe interiors, while 25% consists of low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and expands at the distal tips. A distinct dark circular focal spot is visible in the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding depth of ~15% relative to the vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitudes are irregular, with sharp peaks and valleys especially prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges follow a smooth convex curve from the peduncle to the tips; the trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal trajectory, starting slightly concave near the notch and transitioning to convex at the mid-lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent dark circular cluster on the left lobe; minor low-contrast speckling is visible across the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical dark linear mark is present on the lower-left quadrant; horizontal dark linear disruptions are visible near the upper margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A circular focal mark on the left lobe; heavy irregular serrations and potential tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The transition boundary between the interior white field and the black trailing edge is highly mottled and irregular, particularly on the right lobe.
